BRZE.headline: Breakfast News: A $5.7 Billion Flex or Genius?
BRZE.description: Salesforce acquires Braze for $5.7 billion to strengthen its marketing capabilities, with Braze stock jumping 50%. Netflix faces growth challenges with slowing revenue and weak ad performance. SpaceX beats expectations with 161% revenue growth, while Intuitive Surgical falls despite beating estimates due to cooling U.S. procedure growth. Tesla, Meta, and IBM report earnings with major capital spending decisions in focus. EQT continues steady cash flow growth as a natural gas producer.

BRZE.headline: Stock Market Today, Oct. 20: Salesforce Agrees to Acquire Braze for $5.66 Billion: BRZE Stock Soars 52%
BRZE.description: Salesforce announced its agreement to acquire Braze, a customer engagement and marketing software provider, for $5.66 billion ($47.50 per share in cash). Braze stock surged 52% on the news. The deal, expected to close in 2027, represents Salesforce's continued focus on integrating AI into its offerings following its June acquisition of Fin. Braze has declined 51% since its 2021 IPO.
